## Purpose / scope
What changes, and what user-visible behavior remains unchanged?

## Impact
- [ ] Android checked / not affected
- [ ] Web + responsive UI checked / not affected
- [ ] Supabase / RLS / Edge Functions checked / not affected
- [ ] Offline/Sync/Time/Rewards checked / not affected
- [ ] CI, signing, updates, secrets checked / not affected

## Naming and documentation
- [ ] New or modified identifiers, tests, technical comments and code documentation are English-only.
- [ ] Kotlin/TypeScript/SQL names follow the repository naming conventions.
- [ ] User-facing translated content remains localized; no unintended UI language changes.
- [ ] Renamed public interfaces, serialized keys and database columns have compatibility review.

## Evidence
- Changed modules / important decisions:
- Tests actually run (commands, success/failure, logs):
- Before/after screenshots (UI changes):
- Security and privacy review:
- Known issues and exceptions:

## Release and rollback
- Database migration or API compatibility impact:
- Rollback / backup plan:
- Production deployment approved? **No** unless separately confirmed.

## Reviews
- [ ] Architecture / maintainability (when needed)
- [ ] Security / privacy (mandatory for sensitive areas)
- [ ] QA regression
- [ ] UI/accessibility (if UI affected)
- [ ] Release/CI (if delivery affected)
- [ ] docs/engineering/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md updated
